_readme: Player-facing release notes, newest first. Shown by the Change Log button in the lobby (js/changelog-ui.js). Rules: see HOUSE RULES in CLAUDE.md. Simple English, short lines, no em dashes. Add changes to today's entry if one exists, or add a new entry at the top.

entries.title: Lobby and scroll overflow updates
changes: New: a Change Log button in the lobby shows what changed in each update.
The leaderboard now reloads each time you come back to the lobby.

Removed the separate "All Slots Full" cascade popup. When you pick up a scroll with a full hand (also from Unbidden Lamplight or Quick Reflexes), the Scroll Overflow banner asks you to cascade at the end of your turn.
